summary.text: Angelina Cruz is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 62 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her current term as beginning on January 6, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Angelina Cruz's career experience includes working as a public school teacher and as president of Racine Educators United, according to Ballotpedia.
Cruz was assigned to the Education Committee and the Government Accountability and Oversight Committee for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
